A '''mechanical interface visor''' was a device, which when worn across the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and connected to a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system, translated images received through its visual sensors and scanned them for common mechanical designs. The visor then provided the wearer a heads-up display of basic information and tips on dealing with those designs.
